integrity: Theorem derives from a complete first-hit partition and ergodic pair-frequency convergence; the reproducible checker performs exact rational finite identities and sample comparisons, not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary quantized observable, finite positive tolerances and earliest-index tie selection at delay one; no general smooth, noisy or arbitrary-tie assertion. Historical equivalence cannot be excluded.
title: A four-atom false-nearest-neighbour limit law for quantized Bernoulli dynamics
